assign.title: Concept tiles: fixed 404 links, they now point at the page's own address
assign.outcome:
**Fixed.** `ux/Content/Concepts/Concepts.js` `href()` built a tile's link from `folder_url()` (where the concept pages' FILES live, under `/framework/ai/`) instead of `this.page.url` (the ADDRESS the card is actually shown at, `/framework/ai2/...`). All 7 System design tiles now link to their real address; `it.href` still wins when a concept sets its own.

![Servex concept page, reached by clicking its tile](servex-concept-1920.png)

Proof: headless Playwright loaded the card, collected all 7 tile hrefs (now `/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/system-design/<slug>/`), loaded each one fresh — no "Page Load Error", no console or page errors — clicked one tile from the card itself and it landed correctly, screenshot above at 1920. Posted the result to [the card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/system-design/).

- [x] concept tiles link where the page actually lives, not where its files sit — proof: 7/7 tiles load clean, one click proven, screenshot above
- [x] `it.href` still wins — unchanged in the fix, only the fallback branch moved
- [x] proof posted to card 2026/09/24/system-design — `POST /card/append` returned `{"ok":true}`

Left as-is: the file was uncommitted with no git history, so it was edited directly in the main tree (under a `Server/hold.mjs` fence) rather than through a worktree — `Server/merge.mjs`'s three-way merge can't land a brand-new untracked file cleanly (empty base + a whole file on both sides always conflicts). Noted in `requirements.md` and the task log.
